description: ol-global-outside-root inside a COMPREHENSION BODY reached through a legal root-level global's own initializer. spec/grammar.md:144 makes an expression-block a sequence of statements, so a comprehension body is a block scope (spec/execution-model.md:367-369) that an expression can carry — which is why the placement rule exempts only the root declaration itself and still walks its subtree. An earlier revision skipped the whole subtree and this program checked clean.
